scope: Optional local iPhone audio notes for indoor route marks

checks.swiftTypecheck: Passed with iOS 15 deployment target and iOS 27.2 Simulator SDK
controllerAndStore: Reject invalid WAV headers and the per-route audio byte overflow
Preserve the same mark's audio alongside text, through an edit and encrypted reopen
Verify a multi-megabyte version opens through the existing encrypted store and that its recording does not appear in plaintext on disk
Reject schema 8 audio mislabeled as schema 7 and write a compatible schema when the last recording is cleared
Delete the route with its versions and audio
widget: Opening the editor does not start the microphone; handle simulated permission denial on explicit start
End at the recording limit, preview the candidate and apply it explicitly without requesting a photo
Cancel an in-flight replacement and keep the existing note
Open a saved route and play the correct note only after confirmation and explicit activation
Stop pending replay audio on pause

schema.write8When: There is at least one manual landmark audio note
schema.audioFormat: Mono PCM WAV, 16-bit little-endian, native input sample rate

humanAcceptance: Pending iPhone microphone, audio route interruptions, playback, VoiceOver and field replay
